label: ერთი კადრი
about: The One-Take Minimalist: one fact, few beats, the frame rearranges instead of cutting.
brief: The film is one fact said clearly, in few beats.
First 2 s: the hook is the fact itself.
Then one hero scene that shows it (a number, a place, a picture or a quote) and at most one more.
No lists, no second story: if the articles have more, keep only the main fact.
The viewer leaves with one clear fact.
pacing: 3-4 beats; the hero scene holds longest.
